required_before_oos: Attach a pre-declared executable Candidate B rule specification.
Freeze the executable specification before observing Candidate B OOS results.
Bind the evaluator to this snapshot and frozen specification.
Run deterministic 8-fold walk-forward OOS only after all gates pass.
prohibited: Retargeting Rule A evaluator to Candidate B snapshot.
Inventing Candidate B parameters from observed data/results.
Changing fold, embargo, cost, or evaluation definitions after results.
Merging, rebasing, or syncing data-engine-v1 with main.
Live execution, wallet operations, or production promotion.
